t: The Signature Sleeve System: Pre-Sized Trunk Kits
title: The Signature Sleeve System: Pre-Sized Trunk Kits
description: The Signature sleeve system sells trunks as kits — a pre-cut PET sleeve in the right diameter, two heat-shrink ends, and a pull-through string, sized for standard jobs (24-pin run, GPU run, desk trunk). No measuring, no spool waste, no wrong size. The kit is the job, packaged: open, thread, shrink, done.

demo.program:
print("Trunk kits: pre-cut sleeve + 2 shrink ends + pull string, sized per job.")
print("24-pin kit, GPU kit, desk kit: open, thread, shrink, done.")
print("No measuring, no spool waste, no wrong size.")

title: Signature Hot-Cut Tool
description: The Signature hot-cut tool is a small heated blade that cuts and seals braid in one motion — perfect ends every time, no lighter-fumbling, no frayed experiments. It docks on the bench station and heats in seconds. The sealed end is the pro finish; the tool makes it the easy finish.

demo.program:
print("Heated blade: cuts + seals in one motion. Perfect ends, no fray.")
print("Docks on station, heats in seconds.")
print("Pro finish becomes the easy finish.")

title: Signature Color System for Sleeves
description: Signature sleeves come in the build-theme palette with a simple rule: window-visible runs get theme color, hidden runs get black, service-identified trunks get a colored shrink band (red = power, blue = data). The color system from the strap discipline extends to sleeves — one visual language across all cable management.

demo.program:
print("Window runs: theme color. Hidden: black. Service ID: colored shrink band.")
print("Red band = power, blue = data. One visual language: straps + sleeves.")
print("Anyone opening the case reads the system instantly.")

title: Signature No-Disconnect Wrap Sleeve
description: The Signature wrap sleeve is a PET braid with a full-length hook-and-loop closure — braided look and breathability with zippered convenience, no disconnecting. It closes flat and the seam disappears into the braid pattern. The best of both materials: install like neoprene, perform like braid.

demo.program:
print("PET braid + full-length hook-and-loop closure: no disconnecting.")
print("Seam disappears into braid. Installs like neoprene, performs like braid.")
print("Best of both, finally in one sleeve.")

title: Signature Desk Trunk Kit

title: Signature vs Standard Sleeving
description: Standard: buy a spool, guess the size, cut with scissors, fray, learn heat-shrink the hard way. Signature: kit sized to the job, hot-cut tool seals ends, wrap option skips disconnecting, color system included. Same braid physics — the Signature removes the measuring, the fraying, and the learning curve.

demo.program:
print("Standard: spool + guess + scissors + fray + hard lessons.")
print("Signature: sized kits + hot-cut + wrap option + color system.")
print("Same physics. Measuring, fraying, learning curve: removed.")

title: Signature Heat-Shrink Label System
description: Signature shrink comes in printable white — run it through a label printer before shrinking and every trunk carries its name permanently under clear shrink. 'GPU PWR 12VHPWR' on the trunk itself, readable for the life of the build. Labels stop being stickers that fall off and become part of the cable.

demo.program:
print("Printable white shrink: label BEFORE shrinking, name under clear coat.")
print("'GPU PWR' on the trunk, readable for the build's life.")
print("Labels become part of the cable, not stickers that fall off.")

title: Signature Airflow-Safe Sleeving Guide
description: The Signature guide marks sleeve choices by thermal zone: PET anywhere, wrap sleeves in ventilated areas, no neoprene on hot runs — with a simple diagram of a case showing green/yellow/red zones. The guide tapes inside the panel with the trunk card. Looks never overrule thermals because the zones are printed.

demo.program:
print("Guide: case diagram, green/yellow/red thermal zones per sleeve type.")
print("Tapes inside panel with trunk card.")
print("Looks never overrule thermals: zones are printed.")

title: Signature Re-Sleeve Refresh Cycle
description: The Signature refresh: every major rebuild, slit old braid, inspect cables underneath (sleeves hide chafing — look), re-sleeve fresh. The refresh is on the rebuild checklist because hidden damage is the cost of pretty cables. Twenty minutes and the trunks are new — and the cables underneath are verified.

demo.program:
print("Rebuild refresh: slit braid, INSPECT cables (sleeves hide chafing), re-sleeve.")
print("On the rebuild checklist: hidden damage is pretty cables' cost.")
print("20 min: new trunks + verified cables underneath.")

title: Signature Custom-Cable Safety Protocol
description: The Signature protocol for custom cables: pinout verified against the PSU maker's diagram (printed, not remembered), one cable built and continuity-tested before the set, no mixing brands ever, and the pinout card filed with the build docs. Custom cabling's risk is real; the protocol makes it managed instead of brave.

demo.program:
print("Protocol: printed pinout verify -> one cable continuity-tested -> build set.")
print("No brand mixing, EVER. Pinout card filed with build docs.")
print("Real risk, managed: not brave, verified.")

title: Signature Sleeve Dust Schedule
description: The Signature schedule: desk trunks dusted monthly (vacuum brush), case sleeves checked at the quarterly clean, wrap sleeves wiped when the desk gets wiped. It is on the maintenance card because dusty sleeves are the visible proof of a neglected schedule — the system keeps its own appearance as the reminder.

demo.program:
print("Monthly: desk trunks (vacuum brush). Quarterly: case sleeves.")
print("Wrap sleeves: wiped with the desk. On the maintenance card.")
print("Dusty sleeves = visible proof of neglect: appearance is the reminder.")

description: New builders drill one trunk: measure, hot-cut, thread, shrink-finish, label — timed, inspected. Under twenty minutes with even braid and sealed ends passes. The drill teaches the whole sleeving workflow on scrap cable, so real trunks get first-try quality.

title: The Complete Signature Sleeving Discipline
description: The full Signature sleeving discipline: kits sized to jobs, hot-cut sealed ends, shrink-finished and labeled, color system per visibility, wrap sleeves where disconnecting is costly, thermal zones respected, refresh inspections each rebuild, custom cables only verified. Many cables in, one intentional trunk out — with every choice documented on the trunk card.

disc = ["kits sized to jobs", "hot-cut sealed ends", "shrink + label finish",
        "color per visibility", "wrap where disconnects costly", "thermal zones",
        "rebuild refresh + inspect", "custom cables verified"]
for i, d in enumerate(disc, 1):
    print(f"  {i}. {d}")
print("One intentional trunk out — every choice on the trunk card.")
